philippines.title: Civil society groups urge BARMM parliament to shun traditional politics
philippines.description:
CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY, Philippines — As the first elected Parliament of the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM) opened its inaugural session Friday, civil society leaders, peacebuilders, and rights advocates warned against trading a revolutionary legacy for the transactional spoils of traditional politics. Rights advocacy group Katungod Bangsamoro framed the assembly not merely as a legislative milestone, but as an acute stress test of whether the regional government can break away from the clan rule, patronage, and elite compromise that crippled past autonomy projects. “We specifically challenge the elected members of the new Parliament who emerged from the revolutionary […]...
